lead_raw_text:
The structure of FeRhN crystallizes in the cubic space group P2₁3 (No. 1), with a unit cell containing 3 atoms across 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe and Rh centers each coordinated by 6 N neighbors and N centers coordinated by 3 Fe and 3 Rh neighbors, with all environments adopting an octahedral motif and neighbor distances of 2.105–2.117 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is 3-dimensional and connected across all 3 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and edge sharing between N-centered octahedra, corner sharing between Fe- and Rh-centered octahedra, and edge sharing among like Fe and like Rh octahedra.
